title: My heart beats
examples: How fast should my heart beat?
What does it mean when my heart pumps?
Can I feel my heart beating?

explain.say: Your heart is a strong muscle inside your chest.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: the human heart. Can you see the right atrium and the right ventricle? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
It pumps blood all around your body to all parts.
You can feel your pulse by touching your wrist gently.
When you run, your heart pumps blood much faster.
This fast pumping sends more oxygen to your muscles.
When you are playing, your heart pumps blood to keep you going.

draw.text: Heart keeps you moving and playing

faq.q: Why does my heart beat faster when I run?
faq.a: When you run, your body needs more energy. Your heart pumps faster to send more oxygen-rich blood to your muscles.
asks: Why does running make my heart go fast?
What makes my heart beat quicker when I exercise?

faq.q: What is the difference between my heart beating and my pulse?
faq.a: Your heart beating is the action inside your chest. Your pulse is the feeling of that beat in your wrist or neck.
asks: Is my pulse the same as my heartbeat?
Where can I feel my heart beating?

faq.q: Does my heart beat when I sleep?
faq.a: Yes, your heart continues to beat even when you are sleeping. It beats much slower than when you are awake.
asks: Does my heart stop when I sleep?
How fast is my heart when I sleep?

faq.q: Is it normal for my heart to beat fast sometimes?
faq.a: It is normal for your heart rate to change with activity. It will speed up when you exercise and slow down when you rest.
asks: Can my heart beat fast for a short time?
When is a fast heartbeat okay?

faq.q: What does the blood carry to my body?
faq.a: The blood carries important things like oxygen and nutrients. These things help keep all your body parts working well.
asks: What does blood give to my body?

facts: The heart is a muscle that pumps blood.
Your pulse is the feeling of your heart beating in your wrist.
When exercising, your heart beats faster to send more oxygen.
The blood carries oxygen and nutrients to all body parts.

quiz.say: What is the main job of the heart?
quiz.why: The heart is a pump, so its main job is to move blood.

wrong.0: The lungs help take in oxygen, the heart moves it.
wrong.1: Your body temperature is kept by other systems.
wrong.3: This is the job of the blood cells, not the heart muscle.

quiz.say: When you are running fast, what happens to your heart rate?
quiz.why: Faster beating means more blood moves to your working muscles.

wrong.1: The heart never stops beating when you are alive.
wrong.2: Your body needs more oxygen, so the speed must change.
wrong.3: Slowing down would not give enough oxygen for running.

quiz.say: If you feel your pulse at your wrist, what are you feeling?
quiz.show: Feeling the beat in the wrist.
quiz.why: The pulse is the wave of blood pressure felt at an artery.

wrong.0: The pulse is a strong, rhythmic beat under the skin.
wrong.2: You feel the heart in your chest, not your wrist.
wrong.3: While nerves are involved, the pulse is caused by blood flow.
